contractStatus: T01 specification, not an implemented XLSX format
additionalColumns: reject unknown nonempty columns; warn for unknown empty columns

columnRules.temporaryKeys: unique per entity per document; trim; ASCII case-insensitive
columnRules.formulas: reject in every cell in every sheet
columnRules.computed: read-only; changed numeric results warn and are recalculated

displayCodeFormat: PREFIX-000001; minimum 6 digits, grows beyond 999999 without reset; no recycling

referenceNormalization.unicodeNormalization: none; distinct Unicode keys remain distinct

version: 修改 only when unused draft
mixed: user-origin same as source; system-origin keep only
deferred: keep only until feature supported; new/edit rejected

CalculationSnapshot.values: map<registered financial metric, decimal string|exact fraction string|null>
